# Amazon Web Services (AWS)

> > AWS is the world's leading cloud computing platform, offering comprehensive infrastructure, AI/ML services, security, and enterprise solutions across global regions.

AWS provides cloud computing services spanning compute, storage, databases, AI/ML, security, and industry-specific solutions. The site serves enterprise customers, developers, and innovators building on cloud infrastructure with emphasis on generative AI, agentic AI, and digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- Generative AI
- Agentic AI
- Amazon Bedrock
- Amazon SageMaker
- Machine Learning
- Cloud Security
- Enterprise Solutions
- Digital Transformation
- AWS Marketplace
- Cloud Infrastructure
- AI Agents
- Customer Case Studies
- AWS Training & Certification
- AWS re:Invent

## Core AWS Services & Overview

- [Cloud Computing Services - Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com): AWS homepage showcasing cloud services, infrastructure, and enterprise solutions.
- [Why Choose AWS? The World's Leading Cloud | Amazon Web Services](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-aws): Overview of AWS capabilities, global infrastructure, and security leadership.
- [Cloud Security – Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/security): AWS cloud security services, compliance, and infrastructure protection.
- [Cloud Solutions by Industries - Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/industries): Industry-specific AWS cloud solutions for vertical markets and enterprise sectors.

## AI & Machine Learning

- [What is Agentic AI? - Agentic AI Explained - AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/agentic-ai): Explanation of agentic AI technology and AWS implementation guidance.
- [AWS Innovators](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/innovators): Customer case studies showcasing AWS innovation across generative AI and digital transformation.
- [Blue Origin on AWS: Case Studies, Videos, Innovator Stories](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/innovators/blue-origin): Blue Origin case study on agentic AI and SageMaker for space exploration.
- [Writer on AWS: Case Studies, Videos, Innovator Stories](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/innovators/writer): Writer case study on enterprise AI agents and Bedrock integration.
- [Pinterest on AWS: Case Studies, Videos, Innovator Stories](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/innovators/pinterest): Pinterest case study on AI discovery, machine learning, and data privacy with AWS.

## Customer Success & Case Studies

- [Mercedes-Benz on AWS: Case Studies, Videos, Innovator Stories](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/innovators/mercedes-benz): Mercedes-Benz case study on SAP migration and AI modernization with AWS.
- [Condé Nast Transforms Publishing Legacy into Data-Driven Digital Media for AI innovation with Databricks and AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/conde-nast-data-case-study): Condé Nast case study on data unification and AI innovation with Databricks.

## Learning & Development

- [AWS Training and Certification](https://aws.amazon.com/training): AWS training courses, certifications, and skill builder learning programs.
- [Getting Started - Cloud Computing Tutorials for Building on AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started): AWS onboarding tutorials and fundamentals for new cloud builders.
- [Cloud Computing Concepts Hub | AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is): Cloud computing concepts hub with guides on ML, AI, and data science.
- [What is Cloud Computing? - Cloud Computing Services, Benefits, and Types - AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-cloud-computing): Educational guide explaining cloud computing concepts and service models.

## News & Community

- [What's New at AWS – Cloud Innovation & News](https://aws.amazon.com/new): AWS announcements, feature releases, and regional expansion news.
- [AWS Blogs - Cloud news & innovation | Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs): AWS blog hub with cloud transformation stories, product news, and insights.

## Marketplace & Partnerships

- [AWS Marketplace: Homepage](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace): AWS Marketplace for discovering and deploying third-party software solutions.
